👋 SR-190 ROAD CONDITIONS

Be prepared for winter conditions on Guardsman Pass

‼️ Slow down, especially on uphills and corners

🚨Guardsman Pass will be temporarily CLOSED tonight (10/12) at 9:30pm

🚧 Road Closure Update 🚧

SR-190 OPEN: Both directions. Flood control and debris clearing is complete.

📍Uphill: Open at mouth

📍Downhill: Open to the mouth

➡️ Plan ahead: More rain is forecasted over the next couple days. Weather related delays are possible.

10/11 8:47pm

🚧 Uphill Restriction Update 🚧

SR-190: Utah Transportation crew is working on clearing the culvert at Storm Mountain (MP 4.25) of debris

‼️No ETO to uphill traffic at this time

🚧 Uphill Restriction Alert 🚧

SR-190: Salt Lake County Sheriff and UDOT are restricting uphill traffic due to flooding and debris.

📍: traffic will be turned around at mouth.

‼️ETO to uphill traffic: UNKNOWN
